facebookText:
Planning the week around Shelby County school sports? Here are basketball and playoff details to keep handy.

Timpson hosts Gary in girls basketball today, November 10: JV at 6 p.m. at Timpson High School. Center’s middle-school girls host Jacksonville Thursday, November 12, with 5/6 p.m. listed: 7B/8B at Intermediate Gym and 7A/8A at Middle School Gym. The schedule does not assign each team to a start time.

Friday, November 13: Joaquin meets Paul Pewitt at 7 p.m. at Panther Stadium in Longview; Joaquin is visitors. Tenaha meets West Sabine at 7 p.m. at Wolves Stadium in San Augustine. Shelbyville meets Waskom at 7:30 p.m. at Bulldog Stadium in Carthage, according to Shelby County Today’s November 9 announcement.

All times are Central. Confirm with the schools before traveling. Save the cards or share them with a parent planning the week.
